summary: Mobile UX feedback iteration (frontend only) tested with Playwright at 375x667, 390x844, 360x740, 430x932, 768x1024 and 1920x1080. WORKING: on phones (<=640px) Sonner toasts show top-center at top:10px, 16px title, close button, ~80-100px tall, and stay visible when the page is scrolled to the very bottom. On 768 and 1920 they show top-right. ScrollToTop lands at scrollY=0 for product cards clicked from the bottom of the catalog and for all footer links. Product 'Ajouter au panier' and catalog quick-add (size picker) show the toast 'Ajouté au panier' with the product name and size, and the 'Voir le panier' button goes to /boutique/checkout. Catalog sort and filters (fs-apply) brings catalog-grid back into view (top=96). There is no unwanted scroll on the first catalog load. Guest checkout with empty name/phone focuses checkout-name, then checkout-phone, and shows an error toast at the top. Logged-in checkout with the 'new address' option and empty fields reveals address-fields and shows an error toast. Suivi: empty code shows a toast and focuses track-code; a valid code shows track-result; a bad code shows the toast 'Commande introuvable'. The '← Mon compte' back link is on every account sub-page. Addresses page on mobile: the new card is scrolled into view and flashed, 'Définir par défaut' flashes the card and shows a toast, delete shows the toast 'Adresse supprimée'. The address modal fits the screen. Preferences shows 'Enregistrement…' then 'Préférences enregistrées'. Security change-pin shows 'Votre code a été changé' (changed and then restored). Overview info edit on desktop shows 'Enregistrement…', the toast 'Profil mis à jour' and the card flash. The header user menu works on mobile. No horizontal overflow on any tested page at the 4 phone sizes. FAILURES: (1) the account Overview is not reachable on mobile or tablet; (2) the Suivi recent-orders list never shows because it calls an endpoint that does not exist; (3) on desktop, reveal() on account sub-pages targets the hidden mobile copy.

ui_bugs.issue: The Overview page (card-info, card-address, card-prefs, card-wallet) cannot be reached on phones or tablets. On /boutique/compte, isRoot=true shows MobileMenu only. The menu item 'Mon compte' (to:'') links back to /boutique/compte, so the menu shows again. The index <Overview/> route inside the lg:hidden block can never render. As a result the requested mobile flows card-info-edit → edit-save ('Profil mis à jour' + flash) and card-address-edit → addr-save cannot be done on a phone. Verified: card-info offsetParent is null at 390 and 768, also after tapping 'Mon compte'.

Suivi loads GET /api/public/account/orders, which returns 404 (Not Found); the backend only has /public/account/orders-split → {in_progress, ...}. myOrders stays empty, so the 'Mes commandes récentes' section and the my-order-CODE buttons never appear for a logged-in customer (tested with Awa, who has DN-260920-1032). The stale-state fix for my-order-CODE cannot be tested.

AccountShell renders <Routes> twice: once in the lg:hidden block and once in the hidden lg:block block. Both copies are mounted, so data-testids are duplicated and API calls/polling run twice (messages polls every 5s and 10s, twice). reveal() uses document.querySelector, which returns the first match: the hidden mobile copy. On desktop, 'Définir par défaut' and the new address flash the hidden element (MutationObserver: vis:false), and the visible card is not scrolled into view or flashed. The same applies to addr-<id>, loyalty-points and similar targets. Fix: in reveal(), use the first visible match ([...querySelectorAll(sel)].find(e => e.offsetParent)), or render only one tree using matchMedia.
/boutique/suivi (the path named in the request) is not a storefront route. It falls through to the staff console login page. The real path is /boutique/suivi-commande. Consider adding a redirect.

issues: FIXED by tester: the quantity input used 'w-14', but .dina-input sets width:100%, so the input took the whole row. The product name was cut to 'Es…' and the price wrapped onto 3 lines. Changed to '!w-14'. Verified at 390: the name and '29 500 FCFA' now show correctly. Other places that combine dina-input with a w-* width may have the same problem.
The Sonner close button sits on the top-left corner of the toast, partly over the header logo. Minor.

action_items: AccountShell: make the Overview reachable on mobile. For example, add an 'Aperçu' route such as /boutique/compte/apercu, or show <Overview/> below/above MobileMenu on the root page, and point the 'Mon compte' menu item to it.
Suivi.jsx: replace GET /public/account/orders with /public/account/orders-split and flatten the arrays (in_progress + others), or add a backend /public/account/orders endpoint.
reveal.js: target the first VISIBLE match, or stop mounting AccountShell Routes twice (this also removes the duplicate API polling and duplicate data-testids).
critical_code_review_comments: AccountShell.jsx is over 1000 lines and mounts the whole sub-route tree twice (mobile and desktop); it should be split into modules and render a single tree.
Catalog firstRun ref works under StrictMode (verified: scrollY=0 on load).
Addresses.save picks the new id by diffing against the 'list' captured at the time of the call. This works, but relies on the POST response containing the full addresses array.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Mobile customer +2250700009871 (id ddcf6d16-...) with 6 TEST_ addresses; deleted via DELETE /api/customers/{id} (login now 404). No orders placed. Changed this customer's PIN and restored it before deletion. Read-only use of Awa Ouattara for Suivi and Messages; no messages were sent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The storefront tracking path is /boutique/suivi-commande. On account sub-pages, use ':visible' locators because the testids are duplicated (mobile and desktop trees). Track flash via MutationObserver on the .dina-flash class. The customer login UI is account-phone/account-code/account-login. Admin cookie login is POST /api/auth/login; to clean up, use DELETE /api/customers/{id}. Retest: mobile Overview edit flows, Suivi my-order-CODE stale fix, desktop reveal on addresses.
rca of the issue: Overview on mobile: AccountShell line ~52: isRoot ? <MobileMenu/> : <Routes>…index Overview…</Routes>; MENU[0].to='' points to the root, so it is circular. Suivi: line 20 calls the non-existent endpoint /public/account/orders (backend server.py has only orders-split at line 389). Desktop reveal: reveal.js line 4 document.querySelector returns the element in the lg:hidden subtree (display:none), so getBoundingClientRect is 0 and the flash is invisible.
